title: review: S0b: scorecard --parallelism — per-goal concurrency, waits, critical path, conflicts, stale events and dispatch-skip reasons; baseline carries the block
spec:
Goal T-0503, brief .orchestrator/adaptive-parallelism-program.md section P0 (measure before changing scheduling). Base goal/T-0503. Work only in your worktree, commit only on your own branch with the task id in the message, run the full .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh before reporting; report sha and failures only.
Verified facts: tasks carry created_at, claimed_at, pipeline.dispatched_at, gated_at, first_green_at, merged_at, accepted_at, gate_attempts, gate_reds, lineage_fix_rounds, last_merge, failure_kind, reason (rebase_conflict on merge conflicts, merge.py:45), constraints.fix_round_for; run rows in runs/<date>.jsonl carry ts, duration_s, role, task, account, executor (scorecard._efficiency_rows scorecard.py:754 shows the tolerant reader; _stamp at 789 parses stamps). A parallel task S0a writes runs/sched/dispatch.jsonl rows {"ts","free_slots","fallback","running_execute","running_claude","considered":[{"task","goal_id","ready","action","reason","executor"}]} and stamps pipeline.first_ready_at; later tasks write runs/sched/waves.jsonl ({"ts","mode","wave","deferred","applied",...}) and runs/sched/stale.jsonl ({"ts","task","goal_id","risk","action",...}). Read these files by path with the same tolerant parsing; do not import a schedlog module (not merged yet); absent files mean zero rows.
1. scorecard.parallelism(root=STATE, goal=None) -> card {"goals": {goal_id: metrics}, "totals": metrics over all goals, "skip_reasons": {reason: count} (per goal and total), "waves": {"rows", "applied"}, "malformed"}. Per goal (tasks whose parent is the goal): wall_clock_s (goal created_at to the goal's done event or last merged_at; undefined when missing); execute intervals = claimed_at..(gated_at or done event ts) of execute tasks -> max_concurrent_executors and avg_concurrent_executors (time-weighted over the union of busy time); Claude worker intervals from run rows with account != "codex" (ts - duration_s .. ts) -> max/avg_concurrent_claude_workers; medians and totals of queue_wait_s (dispatched_at - first_ready_at, fallback created_at), dependency_wait_s (first_ready_at - created_at), execution_s (gated_at - claimed_at, fallback run duration_s), review_s (review task done ts - created_at), merge_wait_s (merged_at - first_green_at); critical_path_s = longest path over the goal's execute DAG (depends_on edges) weighted by execution_s, undefined when any task on it lacks stamps; merge_conflicts (reason == rebase_conflict or last_merge.status == conflict), rebase_failures (failure_kind naming rebase), stale_work_events (stale.jsonl rows with risk high, or pipeline.stale_check.risk == high), fix_rounds, fix_rounds_after_concurrent_merge (a fix round whose parent saw another task of the same goal merge between the parent's claimed_at and gated_at). Undefined values render as "undefined", never 0 (Phase H rule).
2. format_parallelism(card) table; cli `orchestrator scorecard --parallelism [--goal ID]` alongside the existing --efficiency/--economics/--routing/--reviews flags with the same conflict handling; baseline.save stores card["totals"], skip_reasons and waves under "parallelism", baseline compare prints deltas for its numeric fields and tolerates baselines without the block (sched-pre.json lacks it). README scorecard section: one paragraph.
3. Tests: tests/test_scorecard.py test_parallelism_concurrency_sweep_and_waits, test_parallelism_critical_path_over_dag, test_parallelism_skip_reasons_from_sched_log, test_parallelism_missing_files_are_zero; tests/test_baseline.py test_baseline_carries_parallelism_block; tests/test_cli.py test_scorecard_parallelism_flag. Existing tests stay green.
acceptance: orchestrator scorecard --parallelism prints per-goal and total max/avg concurrent executors and Claude workers, median queue, dependency, execution, review and merge waits, wall clock, critical path, merge conflicts, rebase failures, stale-work events, fix rounds and dispatch-skip reason counts; missing stamps show undefined and missing sched files count as zero
baseline save writes a parallelism block and baseline compare prints its deltas, tolerating an older baseline without the block

tests test_parallelism_concurrency_sweep_and_waits, test_parallelism_critical_path_over_dag, test_parallelism_skip_reasons_from_sched_log, test_parallelism_missing_files_are_zero, test_baseline_carries_parallelism_block, test_scorecard_parallelism_flag pass and the full .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0

comments.issue: critical_path_s is set to None whenever ANY execute task in the goal lacks a defined duration, not just tasks on the longest path. `longest(tid)` propagates None through the whole DP for every task with durations[tid] is None, and `paths[gid] = max(lengths) if ... all(v is not None for v in lengths) else None` requires every task's longest() to be defined. So one unrelated, still-in-flight task (no gated_at, no run rows) with zero dependency relation to the actual critical chain makes critical_path_s report undefined for the whole goal, even though the true longest path is fully known. Spec says 'undefined when any task on it lacks stamps', i.e. on the path itself, not on every task in the goal's execute set. This will make critical_path_s report undefined for essentially any goal that still has in-flight tasks, which is the common case when running the scorecard mid-goal.

_parallelism_deltas treats a skip_reasons key missing from one snapshot as None ('undefined') via before.get(key)/after.get(key), even though a reason absent from a dispatch-skip-reasons dict genuinely means zero occurrences that period, not missing telemetry. format_comparison then prints 'after: undefined' for a reason that simply didn't fire, misrepresenting a real zero as unknown data and contradicting the stated rule that undefined must mean missing evidence, not a count of zero.
